instruction: Clonezilla start disk imaging with auto mode and grub reinstall
output: ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p true savedisk 2024-06-backup sda
ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p true restoredisk 2024-06-backup sda

instruction: Clonezilla save partition with compression and checksum
output: ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p true saveparts 2024-06-part sda1

instruction: Clonezilla restore partitions with queue mode
output: ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p true restoreparts 2024-06-part sda1

instruction: Clonezilla with batch option and poweroff on completion
output: ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p poweroff savedisk backup sda
ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p reboot savedisk backup sda

instruction: Clonezilla using multicasting for mass deployment
output: ocs-live-netconfig && ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p true savedisk multicast sda
ocs-sr --help | head -40

instruction: Guymager acquire forensic image with Encase EWF format
output: guymager --guymager-cmd=acquire /dev/sda ewf:case:evidence:examiner:description:notes

instruction: Guymager acquire dd raw image to file
output: guymager --guymager-cmd=acquire /dev/sda dd:/mnt/evidence/sda.dd
guymager --guymager-cmd=list
guymager --guymager-cmd=verify /mnt/evidence/sda.dd
guymager --guymager-cmd=acquire /dev/sda ewf:case:evidence:examiner --hash=sha256
ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -fsck -p true savedisk precheck sda

instruction: Guymager acquire split EWF segments of 2GiB each
output: guymager --guymager-cmd=acquire /dev/sda ewf:case:evidence:examiner --split=2G
ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p true -enc savedisk encrypted sda
ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p true -icrc restoredisk backup sda
guymager --guymager-cmd=acquire /dev/sda aff:/mnt/evidence/sda.aff
guymager --version 2>&1 || echo 'guymager is GUI-based; run without --guymager-cmd'
ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p true -batch savedisk unattended sda

instruction: Clonezilla check partition table before save
output: ocs-sr -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p true -chkpt savedisk checkpt sda

instruction: Guymager verify with hash comparison from log
output: guymager --guymager-cmd=verify /mnt/evidence/sda.E01
ocs-sr --dry-run -g auto -e1 auto -e2 -r -j2 -c -p true savedisk test sda
